description:
As an Infrastructure Engineer in this role, you will be responsible for architecting and maintaining scalable, resilient systems that support high-volume data alerting within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will leverage your expertise in Kubernetes to orchestrate containerized workloads, ensuring seamless deployment and management of applications. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include optimizing cloud infrastructure on AWS, utilizing services such as EKS, EC2, and S3, and implementing infrastructure as cod with Terraform to automate provisioning and configuration. You will also be tasked with designing robust routing and DNS solutions to guarantee high availability and performance across distributed systems.
 
 Success in this position will be driven by your hands-on experience with messaging platforms like RabbitMQ and Kafka, which are essential for handling large-scale data streams and ensuring reliable communication between services. You will benefit from familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, as well as logging and alerting frameworks that enable proactive incident response. Exposure to DevOps methodologies will be crucial, as you will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines and enhance operational efficiency. Your ability to troubleshoot complex issues and implement best practices in cloud security and automation will set you apart in this challenging and rewarding role.
 Requirements 
 Active Security Clearance with appropriate Polygraph 
 Experience with:
 Kubernetes
 RabbitMQ
 Kafka
 DevOps
 EKS
 AWS
 EC2
 S3
 Terraform
 Routing
 DNS
 Grafana
 Logging
 Alerting
 Work Environment: 
 Moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phone and printers) and /or occasional Loud noise (airfield, large equipment). 
 Ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time. 
 
 Physical Demands: 
 While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to sit, stand, talk, and hear. 
 Employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers to operate a computer. 
 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
 
 Travel: 
 Up to 10%/ Occasional travel. 
 
 Avalore will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants who are unable to utilize our online application system due to a disability. Please send your request to hr@avalore.ai. 
 Avalore is an Equal Opportunity Employer - We not discriminate based on age, race, national or ethnic origin, gender, veterans status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected class. Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws.
 Benefits 
 Eligibility requirements apply.
 
 Employer Contributions to Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
 Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) with a generous matching program
 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
 Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
 Short Term & Long Term Disability
 Training & Development
 Employee Assistance Program
 Salary at Avalore is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual's particular combinaition of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements.
